newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Cool wet U.S. weather keeps European feeds subdued.
newsitem.headline: Cool wet U.S. weather keeps European feeds subdued.

text.p: Forecasts for cool and wet weather in the U.S. Midwest and a strong dollar kept a firm lid on activity on the European meals and feeds market, dealers said.
Only three trades were reported this afternoon. Arrived Brazilian soymeal pellets traded unchanged at $278 a tonne cif Rotterdam, Aug Dutch high protein dollars a tonne fob Rotterdam.
Arrived Thai tapioca pellets changed hands at 17.95 marks per 100 kg fob Ghent.
"There was little business as most dealers expected Chicago futures to drop on U.S. weather forecasts," a broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
